name: footer-region-selector
title: Region footer
description: A footer with a built-in region picker: country, language and currency chosen from house selects and handed to your callback.
docs: options lists the countries (leave countries out for all of them), the suggested countries that come first, the languages, each named in itself, and the currencies. Control it with region and onRegionChange, or let it keep the state with defaultRegion; either way the callback gets the full triple { country, language, currency } on every change and nothing navigates. The summary line says the choice in words, and the country names come from Intl.DisplayNames in the language of locale. Below md the group is one button, named by the summary, that opens a dialog with the same three fields. onRegionChange is a function, so use the footer from a Client Component or pass a Server Action. labels translates every visible word, the headings and the empty message of the country list included, navLabel names the footer navigation, and linkAs renders your router's Link.
